CustomField.description: Converts date/time of Visit Date into text (mainly for reporting purposes)
CustomField.formula:
IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 1, "January", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 2, "February", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 3, "March", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 4, "April", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 5, "May", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 6, "June", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 7, "July", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 8, "August", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 9, "September", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 10, "October", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 11, "November", IF(MONTH(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )) = 12, "December", NULL))))))))))))
&" "&
TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )))
&", "&
TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE( Visit_Date__c )))
&" "&
IF( OR( VALUE( MID( TEXT( Visit_Date__c - 7/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) = 0, VALUE( MID( TEXT( Visit_Date__c - 7/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) = 12 ), "12", TEXT( VALUE( MID( TEXT( Visit_Date__c - 7/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) - IF( VALUE( MID( TEXT( Visit_Date__c - 7/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) < 12, 0, 12 ) ) ) & ":" & MID( TEXT( Visit_Date__c - 7/24 ), 15, 2 ) & " " & IF( VALUE( MID( TEXT( Visit_Date__c - 7/24 ), 12, 2 ) ) < 12, "AM", "PM" )
CustomField.label: Visit Date (Text Format)
